name: the-failed-heart-drug
why: Opens on a meeting about a chest-pain drug that did nothing, escalates through volunteers who will not hand back the pills, newspapers and profit bars rising together and a bald man turning into a sheepdog, and pays off on the chalkboard: two failed drugs, three gold stars, and every scientist shrugs.

name: the-hundred-room-mansion
why: The hook is 'you're ignoring 88% of your own biology' over a mansion where every scientist lives in the bathroom while germs party behind 88 padlocked doors, and it ends with the only search plan, a sleepwalking scientist, falling down the stairwell.

name: the-yacht-is-new
why: A $500 ward where patients sit up before day 100 turns out to be the bottom block of an 82-times-taller $41,000 bar of marble, clerks and yachts, and pays off when the CEO christens his third yacht with a pill bottle.
